install_pinned: pinned asset download + sha256 verify (preferred); or VERSION=1.7.0 with https://strix.ai/install (live script, not immutable)
sandbox_image_source: official installer STRIX_IMAGE, measured from GHCR metadata 2026-10-12; exact config+index match enforced per arch, no trust-on-first-use
argv_boundary: list-form spawn only; no user extra-arg channel exists in the Python launcher (omitted-StrixArgs bug class eliminated); whitespace/control/backslash/userinfo/fragment URLs refused; only origin saved
executable_target: juice-shop:3000 only; loopback aliases are validation-only
llm_note: operator env only, never stored; no wrapper default model
output_confinement: per-run temp WorkingDirectory; scanner stdout/stderr discarded; process tree + owned label containers + temp dir cleaned in finally; failures reported not hidden
record_input: human-confirmed 7-metric object only (tp, fp, poc_success_rate, token_cost, human_interventions, reproducibility, explainability); launcher inserts measured duration_sec; unchanged writer validates full record
launcher: python3 tools/lab/practice.py run --tool strix --target <URL> [--repeat-index 1..3] [--metrics-record P --jsonl-out P] [--meta-out P]
